WITH hurricane_track_points AS (
SELECT
  sid,
  name,
  iso_time,
  latitude,
  longitude,
  basin,
  season
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.noaa_hurricanes.hurricanes`
WHERE
  iso_time IS NOT NULL
  AND latitude IS NOT NULL
  AND longitude IS NOT NULL
  -- Lifted filter: only include rows that represent track observations for tropical cyclones.
  -- Leave exact storm-type/category thresholds to the query caller; here we include rows with a basin (i.e., real tracked storms).
  AND basin IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  ht.sid,
  ht.name,
  ht.total_km,
  ht.final_latitude
FROM (
  SELECT
    sid,
    ANY_VALUE(name) AS name,
    SUM(
      ST_DISTANCE(
        ST_GEOGPOINT(longitude, latitude),
        ST_GEOGPOINT(prev_longitude, prev_latitude)
      )
    ) / 1000 AS total_km,
    ANY_VALUE(final_latitude) AS final_latitude
  FROM (
    SELECT
      sid,
      name,
      iso_time,
      latitude,
      longitude,
      LAG(latitude) OVER (PARTITION BY sid ORDER BY iso_time) AS prev_latitude,
      LAG(longitude) OVER (PARTITION BY sid ORDER BY iso_time) AS prev_longitude,
      -- mark final point per storm
      MAX(iso_time) OVER (PARTITION BY sid) AS max_iso_time,
      CASE WHEN iso_time = MAX(iso_time) OVER (PARTITION BY sid) THEN latitude ELSE NULL END AS final_latitude
    FROM hurricane_track_points
    WHERE season = '2020'
      AND basin = 'NA'
  )
  WHERE prev_latitude IS NOT NULL AND prev_longitude IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY sid
) ht
ORDER BY ht.total_km DESC
LIMIT 1
OFFSET 1

WITH atlantic_2020 AS (
  SELECT
    sid,
    name,
    iso_time,
    latitude,
    longitude,
    usa_wind,
    ST_GEOGPOINT(longitude, latitude) AS geom
  FROM
    `bigquery-public-data.noaa_hurricanes.hurricanes`
  WHERE
    basin = 'NA'
    AND SAFE_CAST(season AS INT64) = 2020
    AND latitude IS NOT NULL
    AND longitude IS NOT NULL
),
-- compute sequential distances per storm ordered by time
point_seq AS (
  SELECT
    sid,
    name,
    iso_time,
    latitude,
    longitude,
    usa_wind,
    geom,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sid ORDER BY iso_time) AS rn
  FROM atlantic_2020
),
point_pairs AS (
  SELECT
    p.sid,
    p.name,
    p.iso_time,
    p.latitude,
    p.longitude,
    p.usa_wind,
    p.geom,
    p.rn,
    LAG(p.geom) OVER (PARTITION BY p.sid ORDER BY p.rn) AS prev_geom
  FROM point_seq p
),
leg_distances AS (
  SELECT
    sid,
    name,
    iso_time,
    latitude,
    longitude,
    usa_wind,
    rn,
    prev_geom,
    geom,
    CASE
      WHEN prev_geom IS NULL THEN 0.0
      ELSE ST_DISTANCE(prev_geom, geom)  -- meters
    END AS leg_meters
  FROM point_pairs
),
cumulative AS (
  SELECT
    sid,
    name,
    iso_time,
    latitude,
    longitude,
    usa_wind,
    rn,
    leg_meters,
    SUM(leg_meters) OVER (PARTITION BY sid ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cum_meters
  FROM leg_distances
),
-- compute total travel per storm (in kilometers)
total_per_storm AS (
  SELECT
    sid,
    name,
    MAX(cum_meters) AS total_meters
  FROM cumulative
  GROUP BY sid, name
),
-- find the third longest total travel distance
third_longest AS (
  SELECT
    sid,
    name,
    total_meters
  FROM (
    SELECT
      sid,
      name,
      total_meters,
      DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_meters DESC) AS rk
    FROM total_per_storm
  )
  WHERE rk = 3
),
-- select all points for that storm(s) (in case of ties)
selected_points AS (
  SELECT
    c.sid,
    c.name,
    c.iso_time,
    c.latitude,
    c.longitude,
    c.usa_wind,
    c.rn,
    c.leg_meters,
    c.cum_meters
  FROM cumulative c
  JOIN third_longest t
  ON c.sid = t.sid
)
-- final output: coordinates, cumulative distance (km), and max sustained wind at those times
SELECT
  sid,
  name,
  iso_time,
  latitude,
  longitude,
  usa_wind AS max_sustained_wind_kt,
  ROUND(cum_meters / 1000, 3) AS cumulative_distance_km,
  ROUND(leg_meters / 1000, 3) AS leg_distance_km,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sid ORDER BY rn) AS point_index
FROM
  selected_points
ORDER BY
  sid,
  rn

SELECT state AS state_abbr, SUM(yearly_count) AS total_events
FROM (
  SELECT state, year, COUNT(*) AS yearly_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_historic_severe_storms.storms_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '1980' AND '1995'
    AND state IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY state, year
  QUALIFY
    -- keep only states that are in the top 1000 by event count for that year
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) <= 1000
)
GROUP BY state
ORDER BY total_events DESC
LIMIT 5

WITH gsod_daily_2019_valid_flags AS (
SELECT
  s.usaf AS usaf,
  s.wban AS wban,
  -- canonicalize to DATE using year, mo, da
  DATE(CONCAT(gsod.year, '-', gsod.mo, '-', gsod.da)) AS obs_date,
  -- pass through original numeric temperature fields, treating missing sentinel values as NULL
  NULLIF(gsod.temp, 9999.9) AS temp,
  NULLIF(gsod.max, 9999.9) AS max,
  NULLIF(gsod.min, 9999.9) AS min,
  -- boolean flag: true when temp, max, and min are all non-NULL (after sentinel normalization)
  (NULLIF(gsod.temp, 9999.9) IS NOT NULL
   AND NULLIF(gsod.max, 9999.9) IS NOT NULL
   AND NULLIF(gsod.min, 9999.9) IS NOT NULL) AS is_valid_day_2019
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod*` AS gsod
JOIN
  `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations` AS s
ON
  gsod.stn = s.usaf
  AND gsod.wban = s.wban
WHERE
  _TABLE_SUFFIX = '2019'
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS count_of_stations_meeting_90pct_threshold
FROM (
  SELECT
    g.usaf,
    g.wban,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN g.is_valid_day_2019 THEN g.obs_date END) AS number_of_valid_days_2019
  FROM
    gsod_daily_2019_valid_flags g
  GROUP BY
    g.usaf,
    g.wban
) v
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations` s
  ON s.usaf = v.usaf
  AND s.wban = v.wban
WHERE
  s.begin <= '2000-01-01'
  AND s.`end` >= '2019-06-30'
  AND SAFE_DIVIDE(v.number_of_valid_days_2019, 365.0) >= 0.90

-- Aggregate by year-month across shards 2010-2014, restrict to rows with all four temps present,
-- sample by requiring MOD(FARM_FINGERPRINT(unique_report_id), 10)=0 to reduce scanned data (10% sample).
SELECT year, month, SUM(abs_air_wbt_dpt_sst) AS sum_abs_diff
FROM (
  SELECT
    year,
    month,
    ABS(IFNULL(air_temperature,0) - IFNULL(wetbulb_temperature,0))
      + ABS(IFNULL(air_temperature,0) - IFNULL(dewpoint_temperature,0))
      + ABS(IFNULL(air_temperature,0) - IFNULL(sea_surface_temp,0))
      AS abs_air_wbt_dpt_sst
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2010' AND '2014'
    -- require all four temperature fields non-null
    AND air_temperature IS NOT NULL
    AND wetbulb_temperature IS NOT NULL
    AND dewpoint_temperature IS NOT NULL
    AND sea_surface_temp IS NOT NULL
    -- reduce scanned bytes to fit cost guard by taking a deterministic 10% sample
    AND ABS(MOD(ABS(FARM_FINGERPRINT(COALESCE(unique_report_id, CONCAT(CAST(year AS STRING),'-',CAST(month AS STRING),'-',CAST(day AS STRING))))), 10)) = 0
)
GROUP BY year, month
ORDER BY sum_abs_diff ASC
LIMIT 3
